scope: Local document backend, shared entity/query/revision/access/authority suite, independent filesystem persistence and installed public API. No personal migration or document coordinator.

Clean locked source install, full tests, fresh tarball consumer, public document export and physical document example; existing local workflows and installation examples retained.

capabilities.atomic_writes: One scoped entity write includes current access and history

limitations: One host, macOS/Linux local filesystem; synced/network folders are not supported.
The caller and filesystem owner are trusted. Document hashes are not adversarial host confinement or rollback detection.
A writer killed before/after HEAD publication leaves its lock; subsequent writes require offline inspection. There is no automatic repair or orphan cleanup.
10,000 committed revisions; 16 MiB per document/index; queries scan current documents.
